study type: Cohort study for prediction model development
cohort: The study included 1299 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from the Lifestyle Intervention IN Gestational Diabetes (LIVING) study.
finding: The developed antenatal and postnatal models effectively predict the risk of Type 2 Diabetes (T2DM) in women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) with good to excellent predictive ability (AUC 0.76 and 0.85 respectively).
